verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents controls over which events are saved and counted toward the event quota. It also offers two ways to handle daily quota overages, 'capture every event' or 'rate limiting'; rate limiting bounds what an error storm can consume. Dashboard discard rules can be enforced at the SDK source, and before-notify callbacks can drop events client-side. Missing for 10: explicit per-project event quota caps, an explicit spend limit or billing cap, and independent or hands-on confirmation that overages never produce surprise charges.
